pageProps.title: Mosalmool Main Store
pageProps.review: This is a visit review of a Korean restaurant where I tasted spicy and sweet Ggaek-ju-ri jorim at Mosalmool Main Store in Jeju-si, Jeju-do, and was impressed by the fresh raw fish provided as a basic side dish.
pageProps.content: ## Ordered ```menu { "title": "Ggaek-ju-ri Jorim", "rating": 4.5 } --- Spicy and sweet delicious jorim. ``` ## Review It was my first time eating Ggaek-ju-ri jorim, and I really enjoyed it without any repulsion. The fact that fresh raw fish comes out as a basic side dish was also very good. ## Pictures
